coverage.evidence: Admission checks signed Gate 0 evidence, current inventory and cleanup hashes, supplemental/control-file hashes, storage budgets, retention state, certified template identity, and active or unreconciled leases. begin_experiment rejects invalid estimates, unauthorized runner paths, identity overrides, and noncanonical output paths.

coverage.area: Wine executable, PATH, and DYLD selection
coverage.evidence: Launch accepts only the certified absolute Wine executable or fixed /usr/bin/arch -x86_64 form, rechecks executable/candidate/runtime identity before spawn, restricts DYLD components to canonical roots, rewrites only the exact legacy alias, and constrains differing-hash fallback to the certified runtime path and order.

PrefixLease rechecks admission and storage limits under shared locks, binds clone and published-prefix directory identities, supervises managed processes, and deletes only the bound prefix after Wine shutdown. Uncertain identity, incomplete cleanup, or an unreaped process preserves reconciliation evidence and keeps admission blocked.

NativeRunLease binds the signed architecture and manifest, hashes thin Mach-O files through no-follow descriptors, rejects mismatches, and rechecks executable and dylib identities before spawn. Runner authentication checks the authorized path and hash.

limitations: Lease and launcher tests use synthetic files and mocked process launches; they do not demonstrate a real Wine process, real prefix run, or loader resolution.
